source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1 Business
source.quote: This drove our decision to open an office in Singapore as our APAC headquarters.

notes: Robinhood's FY2024 10-K gives no customers, assets, employees or offices by state, country or region: it reports ~2,300 full-time employees in total, says it leases offices 'throughout the United States and other countries', and that it serves the U.K. (brokerage) and select EU jurisdictions (crypto, via RHEU registered in Lithuania). No company-published state or country impact report was found. Only sites are recorded.
